user.title: Connect to Hojo TTS
user.description: Enter the address of the Hojo TTS app and its API key. The key is shown in the app's Configuration tab.

data_description.api_key: The app generates one on first start.

hassio_confirm.title: Add Hojo TTS
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the {addon} app so its voices appear in your Assist pipelines?

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the API key
reauth_confirm.description: The stored key was rejected. Paste the current one from the app's Configuration tab.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server. Check that the app is running and the address is right.
error.invalid_api_key: The server rejected that API key.

abort.already_configured: This server is already set up.

init.title: Hojo TTS options
init.description: Pick the models that speak a reply sentence by sentence, so the first sentence plays while the rest is still being written. It suits a model that synthesises faster than its audio plays; a slower model will stall mid-reply. Leave a model unticked if a media player will not play the stream.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Hojo TTS server: {error}

invalid_api_key.message: The Hojo TTS server rejected the stored API key.

list_models_failed.message: Could not read the model list from the Hojo TTS server: {error}

synthesis_failed.message: Hojo TTS could not speak that message: {error}
